title: Franchise file
description: One franchise.yaml: the films and series of one story in the order the story plays, with an optional calendar, eras, and universes. The manual is at https://library.liken.sh/docs/reference/franchises/.

sources.description: Where the author read the order and the times. The next author reads these first.

universe.description: The universe the story happens in. An entry with no universe of its own is in this one.

eras.description: Named stretches of the timeline. Needs a calendar. Spans may overlap.

order.description: The story order, first to last. A depth-first walk of this list is the order.

id.description: A provider id as scheme:id. Films use tmdb and series use tvdb.

zero.description: The event the times count from. Without it, the times are plain calendar years.

before.description: The label after a negative time, such as BBY.

after.description: The label after a positive time, such as ABY.

time.description: A span in the calendar's unit. from and to are equal for a story that stays in one year. Needs a calendar.

title.description: The name the page draws when no library holds the member. Write the year after a film's title.

universe.description: Where this entry happens, when it is not the franchise's own universe.

note.description: Free text for the next author. It never reaches the page.

seasons.description: The seasons that play here, in order. Without it, the entry means the whole show.

season.description: The season number. Specials are season 0.

episodes.description: Episode codes or ranges, in the order they play. Without it, the season plays whole in aired order.
